# Contrib CLI (gsoc-contrib)

> Fast, lightweight contribution workspace manager for GitHub issues using Git blobless clones (`--filter=blob:none`) and sparse checkouts. Sub-3.4s setup, 95% bandwidth savings, and 90% disk space savings.

## Overview

Contrib CLI (`gsoc-contrib` on npm and PyPI, `contrib-cli` on GitHub) eliminates multi-gigabyte repository downloads when contributing to open source. Instead of running a full `git clone`, it initializes a blobless, sparse workspace specifically scoped to the target GitHub issue or PR and launches your editor with a pre-configured AI briefing package.

## Core Features

- **Zero-Clone Workspace Engine**: Uses Git blobless clones (`--filter=blob:none`) and sparse checkouts to spin up workspaces in under 3.4 seconds.
- **Resource Savings**: Delivers 95.4% average bandwidth reduction and 91.2% local disk space reduction compared to standard git clone.
- **AI GSOC & Issue Recommender**: Intelligent recommendation engine matching developer skills and programming languages with official GSoC organizations and good-first-issues (`contrib recommend`).
- **Antigravity IDE & Editor Bridge**: Native flags to launch Antigravity IDE (`--agy`), VS Code (`--vscode`), Neovim (`--nvim`), Zed (`--zed`), and Cursor (`--cursor`).
- **Structured AI Briefing Package**: Automatically produces `.contrib/context.json`, `.contrib/ISSUE.md`, and `.contrib/AI_PROMPT.md` for AI pair programmers, eliminating 80% of codebase discovery friction.

## Quick Start & Installation

```bash
# Run instantly with npx
npx gsoc-contrib start <issue-url> --agy

# Global installation via npm
npm install -g gsoc-contrib

# Global installation via pip
pip install gsoc-contrib
```

## Essential Commands

- `contrib start <issue-url> [--agy|--vscode|--nvim]`: Create a lightweight workspace for a GitHub issue and launch the editor.
- `contrib recommend [--lang python,js] [--level beginner]`: Discover matched open-source issues and GSoC organizations.
- `contrib analyze <issue-url>`: Inspect issue metadata, linked PRs, and estimated file impact before cloning.
- `contrib list`: List all active isolated workspaces.
- `contrib clean`: Remove inactive workspaces and reclaim disk space.
